methodology: Used direct In-Reply-To links where available, then conservative subject/date/body-chain reconstruction. Personal/non-work threads were excluded.

guardrails: Reconstructed chains are process evidence, not proof that every instance followed the same steps.
Thread families containing employee/applicant case facts are summarized only at process level.
Use explicit direct-reply metadata where present; otherwise label reconstruction as conservative.
